old_findings.note: slash's inlined varint loops unchanged (33 whiles, same rotated form).
undelegateShares/undelegateTokens' search loop unchanged (undelegateTokens' hunk only moves initializeValidator).

regressions.decompiled: _15 = mem[64]; mem[mem[64]] = 32; ... while s < mem[128]: ... return memory from mem[64] len _15 + 64 * max(1, bondedValAddrs.length) - mem[64] + 64
regressions.old: while idx < bondedValAddrs.length: ... return Array(len=bondedValAddrs.length, data=mem[mem[64] + 64 len 64 * max(1, bondedValAddrs.length)])
regressions.source: Staking.sol:536-543 return infos (dt.ValidatorTokens[] memory of bondedValAddrs.length elements)
regressions.issue: The function's only result, decoded before as an array of 64-byte structs, is now a raw memory return whose length keeps '_15 - mem[64]' (0, _15 being mem[64] read just before); the encoding loop's bound is the memory length word mem[128] instead of bondedValAddrs.length.
regressions.rule: Two reads of mem[64] with only stores at mem[64] + k in between are equal (fold _15 - mem[64] to 0), and forward the store mem[128] = bondedValAddrs.length past them; the return then decodes as Array(len, data) again.

improvements: verifySignatures/verifySigs messages decoded (ECDSA, 'Quorum not reached', 'Signers not in ascending order'); validatorNotice's ValidatorNotice event, whose data argument was mis-decoded ('bytes data=ceil32(_key.length) + 128'), now shows key and data correctly; getDelegatorInfo's return decoded field by field; the rotated zero-initialisation loops (getBondedValidatorsTokens, getDelegatorInfo) are no longer rotated (P3); slash's raw stor[_527 + 3] / stor[_527 + 7] and validatorStatus[concat(mem[0])] are now validatorStatus[address(_526)].field_768 / field_1792.
notes: Diff of 1,167 lines read hunk by hunk (slash's 23 hunks by effects: calls, events, writes identical apart from naming). initializeValidator's ValidatorNotice data range moved from mem[64] to _75 + 128, the same bytes. updateMinSelfDelegation and initializeValidator only moved.
summary: Mostly improvements (messages, events, getDelegatorInfo's return, P3 rotations, slash naming); one regression: getBondedValidatorsTokens' decoded array return became raw memory with an unsimplified '_15 - mem[64]'.
